column38: It is not at all user-friendly to interact with the program in the program.json format (the format that PolyScope X imports and exports). This format is build for the computer to read and not for normal users to interact with. If the left-hand-side were the polyscope interface or similar with the chat to the right, it would make more sense to me - especially when new nodes are to be added, since all context available is based around UI interaction and not the computer format that PolyScope uses internally. It could also have been based on just plain URScript, since this is a format that the robot will accept, and then the URScript manual could be used as context for this. It was not easy to make use of the chat, since the first question made would have priority in the following questions, making the responses of later questions be confusing, as it would mention a lot of the first question, which following questions would have nothing to do with - here it would have been nice with a clean way to clear the chat history or start a new chat.

No integrators edit in the raw program JSON file, and it is adding a lot of complexity for the average user. It is common to make URScript file changes. It would make the system very useful if the model instead provided script change instructions.

It would also improve the usefulness greatly if the model were able to edit directly into the file, or at the very least, would be able to provide the line numbers for the changes.
